Update the stale code comment that acknowledged this gap.

## Changes

### 1. `src/VisualRelay.Core/Execution/RelayDriver.cs` (line 56)

Add `runId` and `taskId` arguments to the `ValidateCommitGateResumeAsync` call. Both variables are already in scope at the call site (line 25–26).
